This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for June 24, 2026.

Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition.

1. Israel continues to commit genocide by targeting children in Gaza, UN inquiry finds | First Thing. Palestinian children 'deliberately targeted and killed', report's chair says. This was reported by The Guardian.

2. Israel continues to commit genocide by targeting children in Gaza, UN inquiry finds. Independent report says by aiming at children. This was reported by The Guardian.

3. Four Gaza aid flotilla activists released from Libya detention. Global Sumud Flotilla group says six others remain in detention and are expected to be released within 24 hours. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

4. Diabetes patients in Gaza face survival battle amid war shortages. Insulin and equipment shortages in Gaza pose fatal risks, leading to critical health complications. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

5. UN commission of inquiry says Israel committing genocide in Gaza by deliberately targeting children. Israel rejects the new report by the three-member expert panel, calling it a "libellous sham". This was reported by BBC News.

For the full source-backed dispatch, read the June 24, 2026 Gaza edition at dispatches.thebluefernco.com.
